scope: Bounded companion audit of A2 pathway earning illustrations
sourceGrain: one wage record per six-digit SOC and location, not per O*NET specialty
joinChecks: Exact base O*NET code must exist in the pathway CIP links; detailed BLS SOC must exist; unique wage SOC within each pathway; no national/state fallback
staging: Graduate education or a reviewed graduate credential requirement before related-experience stage, otherwise qualifying-route. Qualifications, licensing and training remain explicit; national typical preparation is not a guarantee.
rangeMeaning: Min/max of selected examples only. No weighting, earnings probability, degree estimate or time progression. Missing/zero/suppressed wages are unknown, never zero.
adoptionException: User requests A1 unchanged. Additive public preparation release 1.2.0 adopted only by A2; A1 remains on 1.0.4. No A1 files, builds or deployment touched.
sharedCompatibilityChecks: A2 12 official assessment, pin, boundary and pathway compatibility tests passed at adoption. A1 pin intentionally unchanged; no A1 build run.
